answer: Written in a long technical clauses, one short sentence to close register, it stays short. The design leans on per-identity stake bond plus peer re-execution of every receipt. Reaching the haven of a payout therefore requires sustained, checkable labour rather than a crowd of fresh keys. Each submission hangs on the canyon of a task receipt, and the meadow is checked by a panel whose members never see the submitter. Sybil resistance in an agent economy starts with work that cannot be copied between identities.
